programme.title: Midsomer Murders

programme.desc: When boxer John Kinsella wins a world title in New York, the village of Midsomer Morchard are overjoyed at his success. Bubba must decide whether to turn around and head home, or push through for the big deal. programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Reporter Judy Warren (Kate Vernon) tracks down Josh (Alex McArthur), a recluse who performs miracles. Alien or angel? All that Judy knows is that now the military is involved and she doesn’t trust them. If she can help Josh, will she find the truth?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A medical specialist (Peter Flemming) examines a case involving an epidemic that killed a number of children in a small town. Through hypnosis, he probes the mind of a surviving child (Rachel Leigh Cook) and unravels a memory of "alien" proportions.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: As part of a top-secret program, the brain content of a military Captain (Lou Diamond Phillips) is temporarily transferred to an android to create a superior soldier. But, when things go wrong, can the transfer be reversed? Also starring Robert Joy.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A group of hospital patients and their nurse, Marie Alexander (Maria Conchita Alonso), survive a global, terrorist bio-attack. A vaccine arrives, but there are only three doses. Who will be chosen? Will it be survival of the fittest?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Bernard (Ayre Gross) is haunted by images from his past and the tragic death of his sister...a death he caused. An experimental treatment brings positive results, but also a dangerous side effect: Bernard can now transfer his fear to others!

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When a transport ship Captain (C. Thomas Howell) is rescued after surviving a devastating crash on Venus, strange things begin to happen when he returns to Earth. He did what it took to survive on Venus, but could the price of survival be too high?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A scientist (Gregory Harrison) in a colony on another planet urges evacuation when he discovers that a radioactive star will soon pass over. He has been wrong before, though, and at great cost. Will the truth be accepted in time to save the colony?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Charlie Bouton (Tom Butler) and Melburn Ross (Michael Shanks) create Mary 25, a nanny robot. When Bouton falls in love with Mary and mistreats his wife, a woman whom Ross once loved, the lines between human and machine become dangerously blurred.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A negotiator (Brett Cullen) tries to find out why a grad student (Peter Stebbings) is threatening to detonate a deadly, self-made bomb, unless the government kills five people for him. Why those five people? Is it revenge? And can he be stopped?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Four telekinetic people are recruited by the CIA, who hopes to use their talents to assassinate a war criminal. Their powers produce unexpected side-effects; however, and the killers may soon find that they are the prey. Robert Guillaume stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When Dr. Nodel (Ron Rifkin) is joined on an alien ship by a small group of students to communicate with aliens, it appears that they’ve all been led into a trap. Have the aliens led them astray? Ryan Reynolds also stars. Sequel to “Double Helix”

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A battle cruiser is captured by the enemy Ebonites on planet N-1-8-4. Imprisoned, the crew is interrogated by The Voice, an unseen Ebonite. Who will be the first to snap? And what will happen then? Starring Maurice Dean Wint and Steven Bauer.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: In the world of 2055, men are extinct. Preserved by cryonics, a man (David Keith) awakens in Lithia, a poor matriarchy. He’s welcomed, but when he upsets the natural order of things, the question arises: Can the world men be revived? And should it?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When two archeologists (Lisa Zane, David Cubitt) discover a cocooned alien that suddenly begins to reanimate, the rest of the research team turns greedy, wanting to cash in on it. When the couple refuses, they find themselves numbered...or are they?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: An alien (Rene Auberjonois) and his family live on a secure farm on Earth, where they grow their own food. Most of the aliens believe that the human race was wiped out in the war, but there is a group of humans in the woods...and they are starving!

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A doctor (Maurice Godin) creates a controversial process to reverse aging and disease. So, when an older woman (Barbara Rush) he loves is close to death, he knows he can save her. But there is always a price to be paid...in The Outer Limits.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: On Mars, the Free Alliance and the Coalition of Middle-Eastern and Pacific States mine minerals under a truce until an apparent attack on Earth. Without clear evidence of war, is retaliation wise, or hasty? Barbara Eve Harris and Adam Baldwin star.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A former soldier (Ron Perlman) has horrifying flashbacks from his days as a member of a covert branch of the military. But when flashback star to become reality, he wonders whether he is insane...or if there a new covert mission afoot.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Mac 27 (Nicolas Lea) is Innobotics' newest android. He’s emotionless, but he escapes after a glitch and takes a hostage, Celia (Nana Visitor). She sees human qualities in Mac and tries to convince him that he has feelings. But why help her captor?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In September 2010, 24-year-old Michelle O’Connell was found shot to death in what authorities ruled a suicide -- a case that was recently ordered reopened by the governor of Florida. Michelle’s mother, Patricia, and sister, Jennifer, insist the young mother never would have taken her own life, and they believe Michelle’s boyfriend, Jeremy -- a sheriff’s deputy -- killed her, which he denies. Michelle’s brother, Scott -- also a sheriff’s deputy -- supports Jeremy and says his mother and sister need to stop living in denial. How does he answer his mother’s accusation that he’s betraying his family to save his job? Dr. Phil brings this fractured family together in search of answers. What happened to Michelle that night? Hear from one of the first responders on the scene -- why does she believe the initial finding of suicide was wrong? Plus, can this family put their differences aside and come together and grieve for Michelle?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A woman who shot her fiancé in the leg after he cheated wants to marry him.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The children of Drew Peterson deal with the reality of their father's suspected involvement in their mother's murder and stepmother's disappearance.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Angelique recounts escaping a life-threatening scheme while pregnant.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: When it comes to children and sports, many believe there is a huge problem with entitled athletes. Are athletes being coached to believe they are individually more important than their teams and that the rules simply don’t apply to them? Dr. Phil sits down with parents, athletes, coaches, and students who all say yes – but they strongly disagree about who is to blame. A coach claims parents are to blame due to modeling outrageous and entitled behavior. However, the sports parents in Dr. Phil’s audience push back, claiming coaches need to stop blaming them and start blaming themselves. Then, meet a referee who wrote an emotional email to parents informing them he was quitting due to their sideline behavior. And, a former all-American quarterback talks about the dark side of college sports. Plus, ESPN investigative reporter Paula Lavigne reveals some of what she has uncovered.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: Dad Accused of Faking His Own Death
programme.desc: A man's claim of his father's disappearance leads to a shoking decption.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Secrets, aliases, disguises. These are some of the tactics Dr. Phil's guests have used to manipulate people and get what they want. See what happens when these liars and cons are confronted.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Here comes the bride? On today’s show, Dr. Phil talks to three different couples who are engaged to be married. In order to figure out whether they are simply having pre-wedding jitters or are making the biggest mistake of their lives, Dr. Phil guides them through the questions all couples need to ask themselves before tying the knot. What is driving them to get married? What are their expectations? We’ll find out if these couples want to just get married or to be happily married.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: They’re self-absorbed, spoiled and entitled brats, otherwise known as Generation Me. MTV correspondent Kim Stolz recently hit the streets of New York to find out how the younger generation feels about this label. Don't miss the candid responses. Then, Bradley, 24, says he wants to be rich and drive a Lamborghini, but he only wants to put in 80 percent of the effort. He still relies on his mom, Christine, to pay his rent and other bills. Will Bradley learn to stand on his own two feet? Plus, Monica says her 18-year-old daughter, Courtney, is an “entitlement princess,” and she gives the teen money just to keep the peace. Will mom and daughter get a wake-up call? And Jean Twenge, author of Generation Me, reveals why many young people are narcissistic.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Couples who say their marriage is on the rocks due to debt.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Fifty-six-year-old widow Sebrina says she’s in love with her overseas boyfriend of one year, “James,” whom she has talked to online and over the phone but has never met in person. Sebrina admits she has sent “James” more than $250,000 -- emptying her life savings -- but believes he will pay her back, as promised, when he pays off business debt, returns to the United States and marries her. Sebrina’s daughter, Sarah, says she’s at her wits’ end trying to convince her mother that she’s being scammed -- even presenting evidence to prove it -- but Sebrina continues to send “James” money. Dr. Phil enlists the help of private investigator Doug Kane to look into “James’” claims and find the truth. Has Sebrina fallen victim to a catfish? Plus, don’t miss what happens when Dr. Phil confronts “James” over the phone!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A mom is supposed to love and nurture her children, but what if she's too involved? Reed, 33, says his mother, Margaret, is so meddling, manipulative and controlling that the day she dies will be a cause for celebration, not mourning. He claims she uses bribes to control his every move, including offering him $20,000 to divorce his first wife. Margaret admits that she can be pushy and difficult but says she just wants to see her son succeed in life. Is she really setting him up for failure? Does Reed really want to man-up and break free from his mother's grasp? And, is Margaret willing to let him go? Then, 35-year-old Anthony, star of the new TLC reality show Mama's Boys of the Bronx, says he sees nothing wrong with living at home and letting his mom, Patti, wait on him hand and foot. How does Patti feel about their living arrangement? Will she ever kick Anthony out? Plus, hear how Anthony's lifestyle affects his dating life. If you know of a mother-son bond that's a little too close for comfort, don't miss this Dr. Phil. Reed, 33, says his mother, Margaret, is so meddling and controlling that the day she dies will be a cause for celebration. Margaret says she wants to see her son succeed - but is she setting him up for failure? Plus, 35-year-old Anthony, star of TLC's Mama's Boys of the Bronx, says he sees nothing wrong with living at home.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: Exclusive: The Co-Eds And The Catfish
programme.desc: In one of the most twisted and bizarre love deceptions ever covered on Dr. Phil, seven female college students from Brigham Young University face the man they say they fell in love with online but never met in person. In a surprising twist, their one-time Prince Charming reveals that he, too, was victimized by a catfish who stole his identity. Tune in as the real person who lured these young women into fake relationships comes forward. Who would orchestrate such a tangled web of deception and why? Can these co-eds find forgiveness and gain closure?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Marilyn says she’s fed up with her son-in-law Adam, whom she calls “irresponsible,” “hot-tempered,” “verbally-abusive,” “entitled,” and a “cheater.” She says she’s tired of what she calls Adam’s disrespectful attitude toward her and her daughter, Miranda, and claims that his reckless spending and inability to take care of his family make him a “poor excuse for a husband.” Adam denies her accusations and says he’s a good dad and provider for his family. What does Miranda say? Can Dr. Phil help heal this fractured family?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Sixty-two-year-old Bill and his 23-year-old girlfriend, Bri, are one of the couples featured on Lifetime’s television series Marrying Millions. Bill and Bri say not only do they come from two different worlds, but they have a 39-year age gap and are at different stages of their lives – Bri wants a family and children, and Bill has been divorced twice. Bill’s first ex- wife claims Bill has a history of cheating, as she says he cheated on her and has warned Bri it could happen to her. While Bill and Bri have been together for four years, they say they are at a crossroads: what happens when he turns 70 and she is only 31? Also, they say their families don’t see eye-to-eye, which impacts their daily lives. How “healthy” is their relationship? The couple takes Dr. Phil’s “Relationship Health Profile Test” and learns the results. Plus, Dr. Phil speaks with superfans from across the U.S. and has a special announcement for them. One superfan even gets his own “Dr. Phil” tattoo ... live! You won’t want to miss this episode!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Stalking allegations, surveillance cameras, restraining orders. This is the real-life drama of a mother and daughter who have declared war on each other! Rita claims her daughter, Lisa, is alienating her from her 13-year-old grandson, Koal, and is brainwashing him to hate her. Lisa says Rita is crazy and is using Koal as a weapon to hurt her.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Ray and Deena say that three years ago, after Deena had an affair and they divorced, their 16-year-old daughter, Summer, went from a straight-A student to a violent and out of control teen. The parents say that Summer shoplifts, uses drugs, gets into physical fights with friends and family, dresses provocatively and lies about her age to date much older men. They also claim that she has run away from home at least 15 times -- including a month-long ordeal in Las Vegas, when they say Summer lived on the streets, abused drugs and panhandled for money. How does Summer explain her behavior? Hear why she says she had no choice but to run away to Vegas -- with a near-stranger. And, how do Ray and Deena respond? Has the contention between them compromised their ability to parent Summer? Dr. Phil weighs in and offers the fractured family advice for moving forward. Will the parents be willing to come together to get Summer back on track?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Monica and Lloyd say they’re devastated that their 19-year-old daughter, Jamie Lynn, is dating Shawn, a 41-year-old man. Jamie Lynn is an aspiring singer, living on her own and performing in bars. Her parents don’t approve of her lifestyle and especially her choice in a boyfriend. When the family dug into Shawn’s past, they were shocked at what they discovered and refused to meet him. Jamie Lynn says she’s old enough to make her own decisions and if her family makes her choose, she will choose Shawn. Shawn says he would never hurt Jamie Lynn and can’t believe her parents are judging him without even meeting him. Hear from Jamie Lynn’s sister, who did meet Shawn, and why she says she came away feeling sick. How can this family close the rift that’s tearing them apart?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil answers guests' questions, offering advice to help them enjoy their lives more.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In part 2 of Dr. Phil’s exclusive interview with Gabby Petito’s parents, who are all sitting down together for the first time, they share where they believe Brian Laundrie may be hiding, and what they hope happens to him if he was involved in Gabby’s death. Plus, see their reaction to the latest developments in their daughter’s case.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In part one, viewers met 21-year-old Bailey who says she has the greatest love story of the century. She says she met Jasmine on social media eight months ago and that it was love at first post. She says they’ve been communicating day and night but have never spoken on the phone and have never met. When Dr. Phil first tried to talk to Bailey, she became insistent that her mother, Ericka, not participate in the show, and Bailey angrily walked off the stage. Bailey decided to come back to tell Dr. Phil she wants to meet Jasmine for the first time because she has something important to tell her. Will Dr. Phil allow Bailey to meet the target of her obsession?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Joni claims that Gina used to be one of her besties and that they were inseparable, from spending birthday trips out of town to girls’ nights out, often ending in Gina crashing at Joni’s house. Joni says all that changed when 23- year-old Gina began dating Joni’s 49-year-old father, David, behind her back and giving birth to David’s child. Joni says she feels betrayed by Gina and her father, even going as far as sharing her dislike for her former friend and father’s newfound romance on TikTok. Gina says the picture Joni paints of them being best friends is all a lie, but in any event, Joni needs to accept her relationship with Joni’s father. David says despite his daughter’s disapproval, he is going to continue being in a committed relationship with Gina, but that doesn’t mean he can’t also have a relationship with his daughter.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: One man says he caught his wife cheating – on audiotape – but she denies the accusations. Who’s really telling the truth? Dr. Phil gets to the bottom of the alleged affair on tape. Can this relationship survive without trust?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The courtroom dynamics of the Casey Anthony trial are examined.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Can a man convince his wife to accept a polyfidelic relationship with his mistress?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: They threaten, scream, intimidate and even bite. They’re not tantrum-throwing tots, but bullying dads.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Bob says his wife of 23 years, Dorothy, constantly accuses him of cheating with women he meets online, and despite his vehement denial, she continues to lash out at him daily, leading to violent arguments -- often in front of their 12-year-old daughter, Alice. He says Dorothy has clawed his face, smashed windows in their home and van and even threatened to cut off his manhood because she’s convinced he has been unfaithful. He says he has done everything possible to prove he hasn’t strayed, including taking -- and passing -- a polygraph test, but Dorothy still isn’t convinced. What does he believe is causing his wife’s mistrust? And, why does he say Dr. Phil is partly to blame for the chaos at home? Dorothy admits her behavior is over the top but says she knows her husband is running around on her -- and she’s determined to prove it. She says they’ve been in a sexless marriage for the past two years, yet she found a bottle of erectile dysfunction medication under their bed, as well as naked pictures of women and racy messages on Bob’s computer -- which he claimed was spam. Is she overreacting? And, how does Bob explain the medication? Plus, hear from the couple’s 22-year-old daughter, Samantha, and learn why she says her mom’s “irrational” suspicions even led Dorothy to file a protective order -- against her! Then, Dr. Phil sits down with Alice, who says she just wants the fighting to stop and for her parents to get along. Will her plea provide a wake-up call for Bob and Dorothy?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: George and Cindy Anthony speak out for the first time about their daughter, Casey's trial.

programme.desc: In 2016, over 200 unseen photos of Nazi officials surfaced, revealing the rise of a young Hitlerite group in concentration camps between 1928-1943. Dr. Stefan Hördler spent 5 years analyzing the images, uncovering how these men became perpetrators of horrific crimes. This investigation exposes a little-known chapter of the camps and challenges assumptions about their origins.

programme.title: The Big Attack: Combat Heroes of WWII
programme.desc: An American Intelligence Officer faces off against a brutal Russian Colonel in a tense story about the 'kidnapping' of fifteen German war orphans. Sheltered by a brave Baroness, the children's fate is threatened when V Day Armistice places her home in the Russian zone. U.S. Captain Tom Ryan and Sergeant Steve Maycheck, decide to rescue the orphans and the Baroness, leading to a thrilling climax.

programme.title: First to Fight

programme.title: WWII In Color: D-Day to Nazi Downfall

programme.title: The Big Attack: Combat Heroes of WWII
programme.desc: When American soldiers occupied Germany, they faced orphaned German children resorting to looting. Sergeant Mike Bray was assigned to rectify the situation. He earned the children's trust and helped them establish the Young German Christian Association, restoring an abandoned castle for recreation. The children were sad to see Bray go when he left, grateful for his support.

programme.title: The Big Attack: Combat Heroes of WWII
programme.desc: True, untold combat stories of everyday citizen soldiers fighting during WWII.

programme.title: WWII: The Price of Empire

programme.title: The Rise and Fall of Versailles
programme.sub-title: Louis XV, The Palace of Pleasure
programme.desc: As a military leader, Louis XV, was popular and successful, but he led France into the disastrous Seven Year War with Britain. As his Empire dwindled, Louis amused himself with scandalous love affairs, his own private brothel and bedded five sisters from the same aristocratic family. This is a florid and hugely enjoyable saga of sex, war, torture, gluttony, and some truly astonishing wigs.

programme.desc: Volume 3 - Why Hitler lost World War II: Examines the enormous sacrifice the free world paid to defeat Nazi Germany and examines Adolf Hitler's thirst for power and his bumbling military errors including letting the BEF escape at Dunkirk.

programme.title: WWII In Color: D-Day to Nazi Downfall

programme.title: World of Warships Clash of Titans

programme.title: The Big Attack: Combat Heroes of WWII
programme.desc: 'Tell it to the Chaplain' is a favorite expression of servicemen. This is the tale of a chaplain who, every Sunday, held services amidst ear-splitting gunfire in the fox holes. But when their officer was wounded, the men didn't need a Chaplain, they needed leadership to face oncoming Germans. This Chaplain didn't let his boys down, improving leadership, not taught at O.C.S., to repel the attack.

programme.title: Secrets of the Nazis
programme.desc: Hitler, Göring, and Himmler shared a strange obsession with animals, using them as propaganda tools, symbols of ideology, and even weapons of war. Far beyond affection, their fascination fueled pseudo-scientific projects and genetic manipulation. Through archives, expert insight, and re-enactments, this documentary uncovers how the Nazis exploited nature to serve their brutal vision.

programme.title: Unsealed: America's Conspiracy Files
programme.desc: Some people think everything is a conspiracy. Luckily for them, the FBI declassified decades' worth of government documents in April 2011, allowing people to gain more insight behind some of the most popular conspiracy theories. Each episode of this series investigates a compelling theory by opening these and other files. After acquiring new information, the show's team of specialists re-examines faulty assumptions, looks for inconsistencies and explores new leads in an attempt to get to the bottom of each case. Just make sure you have your tin foil handy when watching the show.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: GLORY 100 features four GLORY world title bouts, four separate four-man one-night tournaments to determine who qualifies for the Last Heavyweight Standing finals, and several key matchups involving some of GLORY’s most popular fighters.

programme.title: K1
programme.desc: Final Elimination tournament for the top sixteen Heavyweigh fighters. The winners qualified for the K-1 World GP 2006 Final.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: Four more will punch their tickets into the next round as GLORY & RISE search for the baddest featherweight on the planet in this year long tournament. On the GLORY side, top ranked German Polish fighter Denis Wosik (40-9-1, 9 KO) takes on Thai veteran Suarek (107-40-11, 39 KO) and Italy’s Achraf Aasila (53-13, 13 KO) meets France’s Lounis Saing (19-4-1, 12 KO). Meanwhile on the RISE side of the bracket, Japan’s Yutaro Asahi (17-9, 4 KO) clashes with Spain’s Eduardo Catalin (17-3-1) and top Japanese prospect Yura Kono (15-1, 7 KO) goes up against China’s Dexiang Kong (35-10). In addition to the Last Featherweight Standing matchups, Shiro Matsumoto (53-17-4, 18 KO) defends his RISE bantamweight title against top challenger Masahi Kumura (24-7, 12 KO) and Australian KO artists Chadd Collins (64-18-2, 32) defends his RISE super lightweight championship against the great Kento Haraguchi (25-4-1, 14 KO).

programme.title: Peak Performance - Jeff Gustafson
programme.desc: In the Marathon Peak Performance at the 2023 Bassmaster Classic, watch Jeff Gustafson's dominant performance as he wins for the second time on Fort Loudoun and Tellico. Gussy started strong with 18-8 and 17-3 over Day 1 and 2, but on the final day he needed every bit of his lead to hold off the hard-charging field of anglers looking to make up weight and try to win the Bassmaster Classic

programme.title: Peak Performance - Bryant Schmitt
programme.desc: Bryan Schmitt is one of the winningest anglers in professional fishing and his great track record is noted on grassy river fisheries. Schmitt ended 2022 with a big victory on the Mighty Mississippi River in La Crosse, Wisconsin. Watch his stellar week in the Marathon Peak Performance of the tournament.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Will Davis Jr.
programme.desc: In his Marathon Peak Performance of the week, watch Will Davis Jr. win his first Bassmaster Elite Series title in dramatic fashion on his home body of water. Davis won by just 2 ounces over Brandon Palaniuk, making it the closest margin of victory since Toledo Bend of 2011.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Brandon Palaniuk
programme.desc: In this Marathon Peak Performance, we take a look at Brandon Palaniuk's amazing 2022 season en route to his second Angler of the Year title.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Trey Mckinney
programme.desc: One week after turning 19 years old, Trey McKinney became the youngest Bassmaster Elite Series Champion after landing 130 pounds, 15 ounces at Lake Fork for the 2nd stop of the season. Watch his week unfold in this Marathon Peak Performance feature.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Joey Cifuentes
programme.desc: First year Bassmaster Elite Series pro Joey Cifuentes dominated the Lake Seminole Elite event and took his first pro-level victory. Cifuentes outlasted the field with a four-day total of 85 pounds, 2 ounces. In this Marathon Peak Performance you can watch his winning week.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Austin Felix
programme.desc: Austin Felix had an impeccable smallmouth record in Bassmaster Elite Series events prior to Lake Oahe, but the Minnesota pro went to another level after four successful days in South Dakota. In the Marathon Peak Performance at Lake Oahe, watch Austin Felix take home his first tour-level victory with Bassmaster.

programme.title: Peak Performance - CliffPrince
programme.desc: Watch Cliff Prince's winning week at Wheeler Lake in this edition of the Marathon Peak Performance of the tournament. Prince found a magical spot where the fishing was on fire the first two hours of every tournament day and it lasted all four days en route to his first blue trophy on the Bassmaster Elite Series. The area was 4 to 5 feet deep and Prince maintained a low profile and fished his chatterbait around grass and over a hard spot without using his forward facing sonar.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Kyoya Fujitia
programme.desc: In the Marathon Peak Performance for the 8th stop of the 2023 Bassmaster Elite Series season, watch Kyoya Fujita take the title at Lake Champlain for the first B.A.S.S. win of his career. The young Japanese prodigy stormed to 5 Top 10's in his Rookie season.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Drew Benton
programme.desc: In the Marathon Peak Performance at the 2023 Lake Murray Bassmaster Elite Series, watch Drew Benton's tournament as he notched his 2nd Bassmaster victory. Benton started the week in 2nd place, jumped into the lead, fell to 10th and then completed a comeback of over 5 pounds on the Final Day to win.

programme.title: Peak Performance - LukePalmer
programme.desc: Bassmaster Elite Series pro Luke Palmer has been dubbed as one of the most consistent pros early in his career. His first four years all found him in the 20’s for Angler of the Year and while he’s shown signs of his ability, wins have eluded him. At Santee Cooper he has his Marathon Peak Performance as he follows up a 4th last year, with a win in South Carolina in 2023.

programme.title: Peak Performance - John Crews
programme.desc: The Marathon Peak Performance at the St. Johns River went to ‪@JohnCrews‬ as he led wire to wire to win his second career Bassmaster Elite Series event. Watch his week from behind the lens as he strived for another major tournament victory as a professional fisherman.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Drew Cook
programme.desc: Bassmaster Elite Series pro Drew Cook (‪@thecutlinetv‬) has been a strong competitor since joining the Elite Series in 2019, but a win has eluded him early in his career.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Justin Hammer
programme.desc: ‪@justinhamnerfishing‬ followed his passion and that dream led him to the Bassmaster Elite Series. After a few years on the Elites, he was in the catbird seat of the 2024 Bassmaster Classic where his lifelong dream came true and he became the World Champion of bass fishing. Watch his week unfold at Grand Lake O' the Cherokees in Oklahoma.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Joey Cifuentes
programme.desc: In the Marathon Peak Performance at the 7th stop of the 2023 Bassmaster Elite Series season, Joey Cifuentes takes the title at Lake St. Clair by going against the grain. Cowboy Cifuentes is a Rookie on the Elite Series but with two wins in 2023, he has wowed the fishing world.

programme.title: Peak Performance -Patrick Walters
programme.desc: Through just 5 years on the Bassmaster Elite Series, Patrick Walters has an incredible resume. He added another accolade with a win at Lake Murray, doing so in impressive fashion. Congratulations to ‪@patrickwaltersfishing5121‬, he is the Marathon Peak Performance at the 5th stop of the 2024 season.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Jason Christie
programme.desc: Jason Christie led three days of the Elite Series event at the Sabine River and rode a great two days of fishing to the winners circle in his return year to the Bassmaster Elites. He is the Marathon Peak Performance at the Sabine.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Buddy Gross
programme.desc: The Marathon Peak Performance at the Harris Chain of Lakes went to Buddy Gross who came from behind to win his second career Bassmaster Elite Series event. Watch Gross go to work and win big in Florida.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Lee Livesay
programme.desc: Walk on the wild side with Lee Livesay and his entire week at Lake Fork as he looked to go back to back on his home lake. Livesay was the local favorite with the most amount of knowledge at Lake Fork, but sometimes that can bite you. In the Marathon Peak Performance of the Event, Livesay wins his third Elite Series title and fourth overall Bassmaster victory in just a span of 18 months.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Tyler Rivet
programme.desc: In the Marathon Peak Performance from Lake Okeechobee, follow Tyler Rivet as he closes in on his first Bassmaster Elite Series title. Rivet is a 5th year Elite Series pro who started his career in college at Nicholls State where he formed a Bass Team and fished in every Bassmaster National Championship during his five years in school.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Brandon Lester
programme.desc: ‪@BrandonLesterFishing‬ fished a flawless week at Pickwick Lake for the 6th stop of the 2022 Bassmaster Elite Series season. Lester took the title and won his first Elite Series title and his second B.A.S.S. win this year. Congratulations to Lester, the Marathon Peak Performance at Pickwick.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Ed Loughran III
programme.desc: Ed Loughran, who is also a practicing attorney, notched his biggest fishing achievement by winning the Bassmaster Elite Series event at Lake Champlain. He leaned on both largemouth and smallmouth en route to his first career victory. He is the Marathon Peak Performance for the 8th event of the 2024 Elite Series season.

programme.title: Peak Performance -Patrick Walters
programme.desc: In the Marathon Peak Performance at the St. Lawrence River, watch as Patrick Walters wins his 2nd Elite Series victory and breaks the 100-pound mark for the 3rd time in his career.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Jay Przekurat
programme.desc: As a 23-year old rookie on the Bassmaster Elite Series, Jay Przekurat made history. In the Marathon Peak Performance at the St. Lawrence River, Przekurat becomes the youngest Elite Series champion and also breaks 100 pounds for the first time in history for a smallmouth bass event. Watch his week unfold in Clayton, NY.

programme.title: Peak Performance - John Garrett
programme.desc: The Marathon Peak Performance for the third stop of the Elite Series season features John Garrett and his impressive week at the Harris Chain of Lakes. programme.title: Peak Performance - Brock Mosley

programme.title: Best of Morning Footy
programme.desc: CBS SPORTS GOLAZO NETWORK is a first-of-its-kind free, 24-hour channel in the U.S.dedicated exclusively to global soccer coverage. CBS SPORTS GOLAZO NETWORK, with its unparalleled coverage of all the top domestic and international soccer competitions across the globe, is the ultimate year-round streaming destination for soccer fans. CBS SPORTS GOLAZO NETWORK is anchored weekdays from 7:00-9:00 AM, ET, by - MORNING FOOTY, the Network’s flagship morning show. Every weekday, MORNING FOOTY host Susannah Collins along with former U.S. Men’s National Team player Charlie Davies, analyst Nico Cantor and comedian Alexis Guerreros bring their unique voices and fresh perspectives to the latest news and storylines impacting soccer worldwide. As soccer’s new staple show for fans everywhere, MORNING FOOTY delivers a daily dose of razor-sharp insights and laughs with match highlights, compelling analysis, entertaining interviews, updates - from reporter Jenny Chiu and more that is sure to help kick off your day. In addition, the Network will feature live matches, pre- and post-match breakdowns, magazine shows, films from Paramount+’s STORIES FROM THE BEAUTIFUL GAME soccer documentary collection and original programming. The Network’s live matches and re-airs utilize CBS Sports’ collection of top-tier soccer properties, including UEFA club competitions, Serie A, NWSL, Concacaf national team competitions, Barclays Women’s Super League, Campeonato Brasileirão Série A, Scottish Professional Football League, Argentina Liga Profesional de Fútbol and the AFC Champions League, among others. Watch CBS SPORTS GOLAZO NETWORK 24 hours a day, 7 days a week and all 365 days a year.

It's the last chance for surfers looking to clinch their spot in the WSL Final 5, defend their place in the rankings, or even rewrite a season. The beauty of Teahupo'o is how it disguises its brutality. In Tahiti, it's no longer about surviving the season. It's about earning the right to fight for a World Title.

programme.title: The Vault
programme.desc: 2003 was an epic year for the FIJI PRO. Andy Irons took down Cory Lopez in an epic battle to win the event. Andy was ripping the entire contest and put the world on watch that he was coming for his second world title. - Andy and Cory: It happens a lot on tour, friends who travel and stay together end up in the same heat surfing against each other. Sometimes ‘friendship' stays on the beach and other times they go out and see who can get the best waves and have a fun surf. Andy got on a roll on the Final day of the contest, throwing down 9's and 10's through the Quarter, Semi and Final. He had a perfect 10 and backup 9 point rides before good mate Cory had even put a score on the board. There were three perfect 10 point scores handed out during this Quiksilver Pro Fiji and Andy scored them all. It was Andy at his best in a year when he won 5 out of the 12 CT events and a second World Title.

This is the second to last stop of the Tour before the Mid-season Cut; every turn, every heat, every wave matters. Relive Final's Day action as the world's best fight to stay on tour and earn critical points in the World Title race.

programme.title: North American Whitetail
programme.sub-title: NAW Kentucky Early Season Whitetail Hunt
programme.desc: On this episode of North American Whitetail we've got two action-packed deer hunts. Black Garlock and Clint McCoy hit our Kentucky lease in hopes of finding a mature buck. On Build Your On Deer Factory, Haynes Shelton and Dr. James Kroll show us some tricks when moving permanent blinds with a tractor. Next, in From The Stand, Blake Garlock shows us how to use trail cameras to locate a buck's core area. And we return to the Iowa Deer Classic with Haynes Shelton to take a look at the 1997 Sam Collera buck.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Stacey borrows an ‘07 Jeep JK from a family and jumpstarts their project with the sole purpose of taking it to the next level. However, the real challenge is to build something the whole family will like and still be able to use on the street or off-road. If you’ve ever sat and stared at your project and tried to figure out what the heck to do next or what is the best thing to spend your time and money on… this show is the one to see!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Stacey puts the finishing touches on the ’07 Jeep Wrangler with off-road bumpers, body armor, and lights... and builds a very capable off-road rig that is still civil enough to be driven every day. However, just before the Rhea family takes possession of their “new” Jeep, Stacey springs a little surprise on them… He enlists them to help him squeeze a little more performance and gas mileage out of the vehicle, just to prove that anybody can do it! On go the performance air intake, computer upgrades, synthetic oil, and even some slick new seat covers. If you have been reluctant to modify your vehicle because you didn’t think you had the ability…Think again! This show proves that anybody can be a gearhead and make their vehicle better in some way. So now you have no excuse to not be working on something!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Stacey takes a well worn, ’73 Chevy pickup that was left for dead in the late 80’s, and starts bringing it back to life by upgrading the suspension and brakes. Not only is this a project that most anybody can do, but it is the start of a three-part series of the major steps that are involved in rebuilding a vehicle. With the way the economy is and the price of new vehicles today, this show demonstrates that there is a better option than buying something new…. bust your own knuckles and build it yourself! Then Stacey sits down with off-road racing legend Ivan Stewart to find out what makes him “the Ironman”.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Stacey jumps back into the “KnuckleBuster” project, and deals with an area we can all relate to… a sick engine and transmission. But instead of getting rid of that old worn out vehicle, you can bring it back to life by stuffing in a new engine and transmission; Stacey walks you through the steps to show you just how easy this can be. But, you must be willing to bust your knuckles some and get your hands a little dirty! After that, Stacey puts on the gloves and shows you how to perform a little surgery on a tired rear-end to get the traction that only a locker can supply. Make sure to turn your head and cough!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Everybody knows that the area most prone to wear and tear on your vehicle is the interior. Well, that’s OK because today Stacey shows you how to dig into one and bring it back to life without spending a fortune. Whether you just need carpet, door panels, or a complete overhaul, this is something you can do with your own two hands if you are not afraid to get dirty. Then, it’s on to the place you spend most of your time… the seat! As Stacey goes through the steps of reupholstering your old rag-tag seat, you’ll see it can be made as good as new. If you are tired of driving around with an old ratty interior and don’t know what to do, this episode of GEARZ is for you!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: If there is one thing that every gearhead dreams of doing, it’s getting their car out on the open road and opening it up to see how fast it will go. Of course, there are a few things like speed limits, tickets, and jail time that keep people from doing this sort of thing. But, wouldn’t it be great if it was possible to do it just once? Well it is... and today Stacey shows you where as we showcase the last real outlaw race in the country… the Silver State Classic road race. If you have a car, and the desire to drive it fast, then there is 90 miles of wide open, two-lane highway in Nevada calling your name! Then it’s back to the GEARZ shop where Stacey addresses one of the most versatile tools you can have in your shop… the MIG welder.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: If you’ve been around cars and trucks very long, you know that vintage, nostalgia, and rat rods are very popular. The question is, how do you make a nostalgia-style car with leaf springs hook up like a modern drag car but not lose the vintage look? Simple… you install a ladder bar system! But how do you keep the leaf springs from binding you ask? Ah... there is a special way to do it, and if you want to find out what it is …you need to catch this episode of GEARZ. Then it’s out on the road to test it out as Stacey shows you just how much fun you can have with a nostalgia-style vehicle. Would somebody please bail him out of jail?!?

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: One of the most frustrating things that can happen when you are building a project is finding out the parts you need are no longer available. This can usually bring the project to a screeching halt! But all is not lost because there is another option and Stacey walks you through the ins and outs of hunting for those elusive parts in a salvage yard. After that, it’s back to the shop where Stacey shows you how to restore those old, rag-tag parts that you find. It’s auto recycling at its best, and with today’s economy, it’s also a smart thing to do!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: The Rat Roaster is back!... and this wild little ’32 Roadster gets even wilder as Stacey starts adding some cool details to lock it into the Hot Rod and Rock and Roll culture of 1969. A cool microphone shifter with a touch of James Bond, a bass drum kick pedal, bobbed fenders and a wild custom Gibson guitar to go with the car are just part of it. There is also a special appearance by legendary bass player, Billy Cox, as he talks about playing Woodstock with Jimi Hendrix. After that, Stacey gives you the low-down on the plasma cutter and why you need one. If you like shows that are laced with equal amounts of cool and history, then this episode of GEARZ is one you HAVE to see!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Some of the biggest news to come down the automotive pipeline in a long time is the fact that Dodge is making the Challenger again. But how does it stack up against the legendary Challengers of old? Well, Stacey decides to find out! First, by “grabbing” a Challenger in a most unorthodox way and then comparing it head-to-head with a 70’ 440 six-pack car. But that’s not all… Then Stacey decides to take the new car beyond the legend by sticking on a supercharger and really blowing the doors off of the competition! If you are a Mopar nut, or have just wondered what all the fuss was about concerning the new Challenger…this is one show you’ve got to see!

programme.sub-title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 -EP80 The Last Gift in Prison is Cup Ramen [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Silver, who once worked with Lupin on a train robbery, stole the money himself, hid it somewhere, and promptly got himself thrown into prison on a rinky-dink charge. programme.title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 [English Subtitle]

programme.title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress [English Subtitle]
programme.sub-title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress E01 [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: At a time when the industrial revolution was carrying the world into the modern age, a horde of undead monsters suddenly appeared. They could not be killed unless their hearts, which were protected by a layer of iron, were pierced. Humans bitten by them would come back as undead monsters themselves. These undead, which would later be known as "Kabane," exploded in population until they finally overran the world. - - The people of Hinomoto, a nation in the far east, built fortresses known as "stations" throughout the land that have allowed them to survive the threat of the Kabane. People can only travel between these stations using fortified steam locomotives known as "Hayajiro," and they have managed to stay alive by sharing resources in this way. - - Ikoma is a young steamsmith living at Aragane Station, a city that specializes in the manufacture of iron and steam engines. He is working on developing a unique anti-Kabane weapon called a "piercing gun" as he waits for his chance to prove his strength. - - Then, one day, a Hayajiro called the "Iron Fortress" makes its way through the front lines to arrive at Aragane Station. When Ikoma begins his usual maintenance routine, he sees a mysterious girl who is exempt from her Kabane inspection. That night, Ikoma sees the girl again and learns that her name is Mumei, but then an out-of-control Hayajiro overrun by Kabane charges into Aragane Station. - - The Kabane pour out of the train into Aragane Station. Ikoma races against the flow of the panicked residents, this time determined not to run away, but to defeat the Kabane with his piercing gun!

programme.desc: In "One Perfect Day in Kentucky," BFF’s Kimberly and Elsa bring their shared competitive streak to the Bluegrass State, facing off to find out who can plan the perfect Kentucky day. Each is determined to delight - and outdo - the other with unforgettable experiences that showcase the state's rich culture. Elsa kicks off the competition with a classic Kentucky breakfast, a recipe she learned from top Chef Ouita Michel at her Holly Hill Cooking Studio. Elsa wins the first point, but Kimberly’s ready to up the ante, whisking Elsa away for a thrilling cave kayaking adventure at the Gorge Underground. As they ride the chairlift to the top of the stunning Natural Bridge, the rivalry kicks into high gear and they go head-to-head in a trivia battle. The next surprise – a toast with Kentucky’s own Ale-8 soda , sourced by Kimberly straight from the factory only whets their whistles. At the Keeneland Racetrack they sip some spirit forward Keeneland Breezes while Elsa reveals all she has learned about racehorses from a visit to renowned trainer Mark Simms Jr. ‘s horse barn. A Betologist gives them a quick lesson on wagering and Kimberly’s horse wins the race. At Louisville’s Trouble Bar, Kimberly shares her newfound knowledge of Kentucky bourbon production from a tour and tasting at Castle + Key distillery and makes Elsa One Perfect Drink.

programme.title: La Viuda Joven
programme.desc: Rogelio pasa a ser una víctima más de la viuda negra. A pesar de las cosas que dice que hará si ella lo libera, es asesinado. Los móviles de la policía llegan demasiado tarde y lo encuentran ya muerto. Simón es arrestado y encarcelado por la estafa a la chocolatería. Si bien dicen que la Baronesa fue quien le pagó para que la realizara, el confiesa que en verdad fue Matías Humboldt. Luego de seis meses, es liberado, y jura vengarse de todo lo que le hizo Iris. Inmaculada tiene intenciones de casarse con Salvatore para formar un hogar y llevar a Neta a vivir con ellos. Sin embargo, la niña se niega a cambiar de casa ya que quiere permanecer con su abuela Helda. Abril junto con Karelis visita al doctor para controlar si está todo bien con su embarazo.

programme.title: La Viuda Joven
programme.desc: Luego de seis meses, Simón es liberado de la cárcel. Jura vengarse de Iris por todo lo que le hizo y le pide que nunca más vuelva a verlo ni a él ni a su hijo. Neta quiere que Julie y Sofía conozcan su barrio, las personas que viven y cómo es la manera de vivir allí. Entre las tres, convencen a Rosario para que las lleve. Christian visita a Vicenta, y mientras están charlando, ella comienza a tener contracciones. Él decide no llamar ni a Federico ni a la ambulancia y llevarla él mismo a la clínica. Christian, a pesar de que Federico no está de acuerdo, presencia el parto y ayuda a Vicenta en ese momento difícil.

programme.title: La Viuda Joven
programme.desc: Abril y Vicenta dan a luz en el mismo lugar y al mismo tiempo. La enfermera confunde los bebés, entregando a cada madre el hijo de la otra. Ellas, mediante su instinto, se dan cuenta de esto y deciden, por su cuenta, visitarse una a la otra para intentar solucionar este problema. Una jueza le da la custodia de Neta a Helda, justificándose en que es la única figura materna que tiene presente. Sin embargo, en un acto de injusticia, le permite a la chica vivir junto a su abuela en la mansión Humboldt, y le sugiere a Inmaculada que se mude, ya que ella es la que sobra. La viuda negra amenaza a Vanesa y quiere que mate a Ivana. Si ella no lo hace, su hija Julie está en peligro, razón por la cual Vanesa está muy nerviosa y perturbada.

programme.title: Cuando Hay Pasión
programme.sub-title: Cuando Hay Pasion - Episodio 19: Ines, profuga, busca refugio y ayuda.
programme.desc: Luis Guillermo irrumpe en la casa de marta helena presionando a esta para que le indique el paradero de Inés tras haberse percatado de su ausencia, la policía llega a la casa de marta Helena siguiendo las pistas del paradero de Inés quien tras haber sido denunciada por Gabriela se haya prófuga de la justicia. Inés recurre a la ayuda de Solbella viéndose sin lugar a donde pasar la noche. Daniela conversa con Chela sintiéndose intrigada por el contenido del sobre que esta tiene en su poder. Robert disuelve las intenciones de Chela al apoderarse del sobre contentivo de las fotografías de Sacha. Inés se oculta de Luis Guillermo quien la busca incesablemente.

programme.title: Cuando Hay Pasión
programme.sub-title: Cuando Hay Pasion - Episodio 20: Robert oculta a Ines de Reina
programme.desc: En la casa de Solbella Inés se ve sorprendida por presencia de Robert quien la confunde con Reina por estar en su habitación. Luis Guillermo vigila los pasos de Robert al sospechara este protegiendo a Inés. Robert conversa con Inés intentando explicar su presencia, Reina los interrumpe con su llegada apresurando a Robert a mantener la presencia de Inés oculta ante ella. Solbella tranquiliza a Inés quien se preocupa al percatarse de la vigilia que Luis Guillermo mantiene en el edificio. Luis Guillermo observa la salida de Robert y Reina del edificio. Tras su salida del restaurante Diego Andrés conduce a Carolina hasta su casa aprovechando la ocasión de hacer remembranzas de su época de estudiantes. Michelle espera impaciente la llegada de Diego Andrés.

programme.title: Episodio 21: Celos, Confesión y Planes de Matrimonio
programme.desc: Luis Guillermo se enfrenta a Robert sintiéndose celos del creciente interés que este manifiesta por Inés, Robert le aclara su posición al recordarle a Luis Guillermo la autosuficiencia de Inés al poder elegir su vida. Gabriela se ve obligada a reconocer su culpa ante la policía tras haber acusado a Inés de robo. En la cancha de tenis Debora percatada de la actitud de Luis Guillermo advierte a Daniela de su posible interés por Inés. Tras las dudas de Luis Guillermo Robert se ve obligado a confesarle sus planes de matrimonio con Inés. Asunta sintiéndose feliz por el regreso de Inés es testigo de su cambio de actitud al no permitirle a la familia Nuñez mas abusos en su contra. Luis Guillermo discute con Robert asegurándose de defender a Inés de sus intenciones.

programme.title: Cuando Hay Pasión
programme.sub-title: Cuando Hay Pasion - Episodio 22: Luis Guillermo quiere irse y necesita dinero
programme.desc: Inés, muy preocupada, baja las escaleras de la mansión de los Nuñez preguntando a la Ama de Llaves Asunta, que quién había entrado en su habitación. En ese momento entra Luis Guillermo indicándole a Inés que deseaba hablar con ella. El tema de conversación era que él deseaba irse de la casa ya que en los últimos días esa casa tenía demasiados problemas y él creía que uno de los principales problemas era él. Que deseaba trabajar y apartarse de todo. Inés le indica que para eso no necesita mudarse de la casa, ya que siendo él el hermano mayor de los Nuñez, le correspondía vivir en la mansión. Luis Guillermo le dice a Inés que no se queda y que necesita dinero para mudarse. En otro escenario están Daniela y Debora.

programme.title: Episodio 23: El Secreto de Inés/Sasha Revelado
programme.desc: Diego descubre quien es Sasha y se lo hace saber a Inés, quien en un principio lo niega, pero luego e explica que él como psiquiatra ha analizado su personalidad y ha detectado su doble actividad. Gabriela habla con Luis y le dice que debe botar a Inés de la casa pero él le recuerda que es la esposa de su hermano. Diego continúa insistiendo con Inés para mantenga clara cual es su personalidad y no la confunda con su doble vida a la vez que ella le pide que le prometa que no dirá nada de su situación a nadie. Diego le advierte que tenga mucho cuidado con Robert quien es una persona muy astuta y peligrosa. Berta va a visitar a Solbella y le pregunta si Armando tiene alguna aventura en el club, pero ella le garantiza que no.

programme.title: Mundo de Fieras
programme.desc: Rosario Flores, conocida por todos como "Charito", es una muchacha buena y hermosa que vive sola en el campo con su madre, María Antonieta. El padre de Charito, Leoncio Palacios, las abandonó a las dos mucho tiempo atrás para irse con su nueva esposa, Miriam. La salud de María Antonieta empeora, por lo que le pide a Leoncio, que también tiene una hija llamada Joselyn, que cuide de Charito. Joselyn Palacios, que sufre problemas mentales, en realidad no es hija de Leoncio, sino de una relación extraconyugal de Miriam con otro hombre, Federico Ansola. María Antonieta fallece después de un tiempo y su hija queda totalmente sola. Por suerte para ella, Chabela Soriano, una vieja amiga de su madre, la hospeda en su casa junto a sus dos hijos.

programme.title: La Viuda Joven
programme.desc: Abril y Vicenta dan a luz en el mismo lugar y al mismo tiempo. La enfermera confunde los bebés, entregando a cada madre el hijo de la otra. Ellas, mediante su instinto, se dan cuenta de esto y deciden, por su cuenta, visitarse una a la otra para intentar solucionar este problema. Una jueza le da la custodia de Neta a Helda, justificándose en que es la única figura materna que tiene presente. Sin embargo, en un acto de injusticia, le permite a la chica vivir junto a su abuela en la mansión Humboldt, y le sugiere a Inmaculada que se mude, ya que ella es la que sobra. La viuda negra amenaza a Vanesa y quiere que mate a Ivana. Si ella no lo hace, su hija Julie está en peligro, razón por la cual Vanesa está muy nerviosa y perturbada.

programme.title: Salvador de Mujeres
programme.sub-title: Episodio 35: El Viaje de los Celos Desatados
programme.desc: Salvador cree que Josefina se dio cuenta de que él está enamorado de Socorro y trata de darle explicaciones, pero ella por el contrario está convencida de que él está profundamente enamorado de ella. Salvador no la contradice, pero acuerdan no volver a tener contacto sexual, para evitar confusiones. Agustina le propone a Socorro que descanse un rato en su casa de campo con Salvador para que la cuide y se alejen de los secuestradores. Socorro no entiende nada, pero acepta y le dice a Salvador quien accede a acompañarla sin siquiera pensarlo. Salvador les cuenta a Josefina y Mercedes para que no le pongan problemas. Las dos lo escuchan, pero se mueren de celos.

programme.title: Episodio 35: Marisela acusa, Ricardo esconde la verdad
programme.desc: Cuando Marisela acusa a Gabriel de no querer que su marido se cure, tanto Gabriel como Arelys tratan de hacerle comprender su error, pero ella desesperada sigue haciendo la misma afirmación. Abril se niega a atender a Alfonso Malavé cuando éste llama a su negocio, dice que todo a su tiempo se hará y Alfonso se enfurece, pero trata de calmarse diciéndose que Brillante es muy poca cosa para hacerlo molestar. Moncho no sabe como hacer que Gabriela se marche sin comprometer demasiado a Ricardo pero ésta le ayuda completando de algún modo la información que necesita y termina marchándose para la clínica de su padre. En tanto que Ricardo no encuentra que hacer para que Isadora no entre a la habitación donde se encuentra su padre para que no descubra la realidad de su vida.

programme.title: Voltea pa' que te enamores
programme.sub-title: Episodio 78: El Anillo Roto y Secretos Revelados
programme.desc: Dileidi comparte un momento con Aureliano en la platabanda, no esta dispuesta a seguir llorando por Luis Fernando, aunque Aureliano no le cree mucho, se toman unas cervezas, conversan y hasta bailan, el sabe que es difícil que ella lo ame pero se conforma, por lo menos esta con el, aunque piense en el otro. Otro que no deja de pensar es Luis Fernando, tiene la compañía de la miss, quien de paso se da cuenta que su profe papi lo que tiene es tremendo despecho y las otras dos que le brincan de un lado a otro, se lamentan de que se haya aparecido con ese mujeron opacándolas a ellas, bueno en realidad opacando a todo el mundo, pero el continua sumergido en el recuerdo de Dileidi. Los que la están pasando de lo mejor son Santiago y Eglee, también baila, ella canta y en un momento que se ponen a convensar Santiago le besa la mano y sin querer o sin habérselo propuesto le saca el anillo que por tanto tiempo y después de tantos intentos fallidos ella trataba de sacarlo, el lo logro, Eglee se alegra ahora si es verdad que tiene otro motivo para ser otra persona, ya no hay anillos que le recuerden a Rómulo. En la boda están sentadas la Nena quien esta pensando en que estado podría estar Eglee, Theo hace de las suyas se luce con todo el mundo y por supuesto todo el mundo se ríe de el, bueno no todo el mundo por que la Nena solo pasa pena con cada ocurrencia de su Doroteo, bueno otras que están en la mesa son Pascuita y Matilde, que no hay tema de conversación que puedan llevar sin tener que discutir, una cree que es injusto lo que le pasa a Eglee, la otra no pues por que al final ella fue la que decidió divorciarse, el grupo el son desafinado se prepara para tocar ante los presentes, Rómulo en esta oportunidad no cantará canciones de los Beatles sino que tocarán algo de su autoría, Betzaida que esta pendiente de todo, toma el detalle de la letra de la canción y entiende que esa canción no es para ella, si no para Eglee, su mamá trata de convencerla de lo contrario, pero ya el daño esta hecho, cuando terminan de cantar sus compañeros de banda, le sugieren a Rómulo que después de haber metido la pata con esa canción ahora le toca arreglar la cosa, pues todo fue muy obvio. Mientras tanto Eglee la sigue pasando de lo mejor con su muchachito, le encanta la manera que tiene de besar, después suben a la habitación de ella, pero dentro de todo ella esta clara que hay demasiado de Rómulo aún allí como para estar con alguien que no sea el, le pide a Santiago que se la lleve de ahí, el accede a complacer a la mujer de sus sueños, de la que ha estado enamorado en silencio desde hace tiempo ya. Luis Fernando trata de distraerse con María Gracia pero las otras dos lo interrumpen a cada rato, luego se ponen hablar las tres de que si están gordas o no, nada de importancia, y vuelve a recordar a su Dileidi con la que si le provocaba tener una conversación de verdad, una mujer inteligente que era capaz de entenderlo, luego vuelve a resignarse, y cree que algo debe salir de esas tres mujeres. Gladis le da la buena noticia a su hijo Aleisi de que tendrá una audición en la orquesta, Gerson cree que con la tremenda palanca que tiene su mamá le darán el puesto a su hermano así no sepa nada, esta Gladis diciendo que ella esta muy agradecida con Marco Aurelio por haberle hecho ese favor y en ese momento entra Gabriel que escucha a Gladis y sin pensarlo le reclama que el también la ha ayudado y sin embargo a el no le agradece nada, también le dice en tono molesto que la vio bajarse de la camioneta del doctor, Gladis que no es tonta se da cuenta que su amigo esta bravo, manda a sus hijos para la pieza y una vez a solar, se las canta toditas, ella no tiene que darle cuenta a nadie de lo que haga o deje de hacer, para eso ella se mantiene, y es la dueña de su casa, de sus hijos y de ella misma, o sea que el pobre Gabito se quedo sorprendido con la actitud de Gladis, el sabe que esa es una mujer de armas tomar. Ya betzaida se quiere estrenar como la señora de Rómulo, pero el no tiene interés en dejar a los invitados, ella le dice que no se preocupe que su mamá se encarga de todo, que se vayan ya, el indiscreto de Theo se les acerca y le da a Rómulo un preservativo y le dice que la pastillita se la queda debiendo, ya la Nena no aguanta mas vergüenza, es como mucho para una sola noche. Otras que casi termina la fiesta son Matilde y Pascuita quienes una vez mas se enfrascaron en una discusión y esta vez fue delante de sus maridos, solo que Ramón saco a bailar a su mujer mientras que Matilde le dice a Gonzalo que ya no aguanta la prepotencia con que Pascuita la trata, que se expresa muy mal de su marido, parece que a Gonzalo no le gusto nada haber escuchado a su esposa ponerse a defender a Ramón. Ernesto y Alegría están de acuerdo que el matrimonio no sirve para nada, ellos hablan en base a las experiencias de sus padres y no les parece que valga la pena casarse, Rosita los aconseja de lo contrario. Mientras su marido habla con Nely que al identificarlo le recuerda que ellos fueron novios cuando eran jóvenes. Santiago lleva a Eglee a su apartamento, allá le confiesa que ella es la primera mujer que entra al apartamento, ella le encuentra una foto y el le confiesa que la quiere desde hace mucho tiempo atrás, que la foto se la robo a Luis Fernando.

programme.title: La Viuda Joven
programme.desc: Ocurre un asesinato más en la mansión Humboldt. Esta vez la víctima es Vanesa. Justo en el momento de la boda de Inmaculada y Salvatore, se oyen los gritos de su hija, Julie, al ver el cuerpo muerto flotando en la piscina. Todos los invitados a la fiesta fueron interrogados. Algunas personas fueron llevadas hasta la Unidad de Homicidios, como por ejemplo Pedro y Sonia, los empleados de la Baronesa, y Ernesto y Laura, una pareja que aún se desconoce por quien fue invitada. Es allí en la Unidad de Homicidios donde se produce una toma de rehenes por parte de Ernesto. Este señor asegura haber visto el momento del crimen, saber quién es la viuda joven y declara que hace ya tiempo que viene recibiendo amenazas por parte del asesino.

programme.title: Salvador de Mujeres
programme.sub-title: Episodio 36: La noche frustrada de Socorro
programme.desc: Socorro y Salvador no entienden la presencia de Darío. Él les dice que fue contratado por Josefina para ser el guardaespaldas personal de Socorro. Salvador decide irse. Socorro llama a su madre para reclamarle y echa a Darío del lugar para quedarse con Salvador. Socorro le pide a Salvador que se quede en su habitación pues está decidida a pasar la noche con él, pero Felipe lo daña todo llegando en la mitad de la noche. Josefina le confiesa a Julio César que está enamorada de otro hombre. Él se queda triste, pero no se siente capaz de reclamarle. Entonces busca a Isabel para estar junto a ella. Le cuenta que tuvo otro hijo por fuera del matrimonio, pero no le dice que es Ramiro.

programme.title: The American King
programme.desc: A mysterious priestess arrives in the USA to fulfill a 400-year-old prophecy: to choose an American King who will rebuild an ancient African Kingdom.

programme.title: Three Kings

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: An ordinary game of hide and seek takes a not-so-ordinary turn when Baby Bop claims that an elephant is hiding in the park! Barney and Riff are happy to play along, but BJ thinks that his sister may be seeing things. Fortunately, Barney takes this opportunity to help the young dinos learn about their sense of sight while having tons of fun! BJ and Riff engage in a friendly contest to see which of them can find (or make) the loudest sound in the park. The playful competition continues to escalateand along the way, the sounds of animals, musical instruments, and even fire engines are introduced.

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: Riff has many special qualities, but sometimes, his shyness makes it hard for him to meet new friends. When Barney introduces Riff to some of his friends in the park, its Baby Bop that ends up feeling less-than-special as the kids seem more impressed with Riff and his special talents. Barney helps Baby Bop realize that theres more to being special than the things you can do. The way you feel and the way you make others feel makes you special, too. Its a special day in the park as Barney and the little dinosaurs enjoy an Art Festival. BJ and Riff share some musical art and Baby Bop shares a painting of a very special friendBarney! As the festival comes to an end, Barney reminds his friends everywhere that no matter what kind of art they make, its always special when it comes from their hearts!

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: When some of the children in the park invite Barney to join them for a race, BJ and Baby Bop decide hell need their help. They show him several ways to get ready for the big race by warming up and stretching. By the end of the day, everyone finds out that there are many fun ways to exercise. When BJ starts to feel sick after eating too many sweets, he lies down in hopes of feeling better. He has a dream about a snack fantasyland where he eats as many sweets as he wants and ends up with a big stomachache. When he wakes up, hes happy to find out it was only a dream. When he asks for a healthy snack, his friends are happy to oblige.

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: BJ and Riff find a pirate map, but in order to find the treasure, they have to be able to count. Since Baby Bop has not learned to count yet, Barney offers to help teach her so she can participate. In the end, Baby Bop learns to count and realizes that feeling good about herself is the greatest treasure in the world! Its time for a music concert in the park. As Riff works on his one-man band, the others make posters for the show. Everyone enjoys Riffs calypso rendition of a favorite song, and they all enjoy helping each other.

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: BJ learns that having a pet is a much bigger responsibility than he ever expected when he offers to take care of a friends dog. When he accidentally loses the dog, everyone has to work together to find it. When Baby Bops favorite teddy bear is torn, she wants to take him to the veterinarian for help. Barney and Riff pretend to be veterinarians. They show Baby Bop that theres nothing to be afraid of, because doctors and veterinarians are our friends too.

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: When Baby Bop is surprised by the first day of cold weather, its Barney that helps her see that winter can be a wonderful time for fun. Baby Bop is getting discouraged, wondering if it will ever snow. Then, when she least expects itthe snow begins to fall! On a hot summer day, Barney teaches BJ about all the fun activities you can do during the summer. BJ gets so excited that he corrals Riff into joining him to do a whole summers worth of activities, all in one day! With some help from Baby Bop and the children, Barney teaches BJ that summer means relaxation, too!

programme.title: Barney and Friends

Baby Bop is practicing her marching because she will be joining a real marching rhythm band and is having trouble keeping a beat. Barney, BJ and Riff help Baby Bop learn about rhythm just in time for her to join the band.

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: Baby Bop has trouble following the rules and taking turns while playing games. Barney reminds him of the wonderful world of books, and the little dinos decide to write a book of their ownbased on the exciting true-life adventures of Captain Pickles!

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: BJs enthusiastic efforts to decorate the park go awry when he accidentally paints the caboose several different colors. Barney helps BJ learn that everyone makes mistakes. But, once theyre gone, she discovers she misses them more than she expected and the more time that goes by, the more she misses them! Barney shows Baby Bop ways to keep friends close in our hearts while theyre away.

programme.title: Barney and Friends

programme.title: Invasor
programme.desc: Pablo, un médico del ejército, sobrevive a un ataque insurgente pero sufre de amnesia parcial. Al regresar a España, sospecha que no le están contando toda la historia. A medida que descubre fragmentos de la verdad, debe elegir entre proteger a su familia o descubrir qué sucedió realmente durante el ataque.

programme.title: Memorias de lo que no fue
programme.desc: En el sórdido submundo de la vida nocturna de la Ciudad de México, Fernando y Miguel se conocen durante una noche salvaje en un famoso club gay. Lo que comienza como un encuentro casual se transforma en un misterio inquietante cuando Fernando despierta a la mañana siguiente sin recordar quién es ni cómo llegó allí. Sin ningún tipo de identificación y perdido en una niebla de confusión, se encuentra dependiendo de Miguel, quien promete ayudarle a descubrir su pasado olvidado. - Mientras navegan por los fragmentos poco fiables de los recuerdos de Fernando, los dos jóvenes se ven arrojados a una relación intensa e inesperada. Su búsqueda de la verdad se vuelve cada vez más peligrosa, revelando oscuros secretos y peligros ocultos que acechan en las sombras de sus pasados. La historia avanza con la aparición de nuevos personajes envueltos en misterio e intriga, empujando a Fernando y Miguel al borde de su cordura. Lo que comienza como una exploración de la amnesia y la identidad se convierte en un thriller impactante, donde la búsqueda de respuestas se encuentra con el derramamiento de sangre y la venganza.

programme.title: Lo Peor de los Deseos
programme.desc: En la lucha por controlar un sindicato de choferes para satisfacer caprichos personales, hay un traidor latente en cada uno de los implicados.

programme.title: Cuatro de Copas
programme.desc: Tres amigos, que después de una noche de alcohol no recuerdan nada de la noche anterior.

programme.title: El 24
programme.desc: Un famoso matón a sueldo, se da a la tarea de matar a Manuel, un hombre que se metió con la amante de un importante jefe.

programme.title: La Boleta
programme.desc: La vida de Pablo es una serie de eventos desafortunados. Después de un intento de suicidio fallido, tiene un sueño con números ganadores de lotería. Sin embargo, cuando va a comprar un billete, es asaltado. Sin dejarse desanimar, Pablo cree que los números aún serán ganadores y persigue a los ladrones por un barrio pobre.

programme.title: Agnosia
programme.desc: Joana Prats sufre de agnosia, una extraña enfermedad neuropsicológica que perturba su percepción sensorial. Aunque sus ojos y oídos están en perfecto estado, su cerebro no logra interpretar adecuadamente los estímulos que recibe. Como única depositaria del secreto industrial dejado por su difunto padre, la enigmática joven se convierte en el blanco de un oscuro plan para extraer la información aprovechando su confusión sensorial. - A medida que la trama se desarrolla, dos hombres clave en la vida de Joana emergen como figuras cruciales: Charles, su prometido y mano derecha del padre de Joana en la empresa familiar, y Vincent, un joven y temperamental sirviente que trabaja en la mansión de los Prats. La relación con estos personajes se torna fundamental para el desenlace de la intriga que rodea el secreto industrial y los peligros que acechan a Joana debido a su condición médica única.

programme.title: Agnosia
programme.desc: Joana Prats sufre de agnosia, una extraña enfermedad neuropsicológica que perturba su percepción sensorial. Aunque sus ojos y oídos están en perfecto estado, su cerebro no logra interpretar adecuadamente los estímulos que recibe. Como única depositaria del secreto industrial dejado por su difunto padre, la enigmática joven se convierte en el blanco de un oscuro plan para extraer la información aprovechando su confusión sensorial. - A medida que la trama se desarrolla, dos hombres clave en la vida de Joana emergen como figuras cruciales: Charles, su prometido y mano derecha del padre de Joana en la empresa familiar, y Vincent, un joven y temperamental sirviente que trabaja en la mansión de los Prats. La relación con estos personajes se torna fundamental para el desenlace de la intriga que rodea el secreto industrial y los peligros que acechan a Joana debido a su condición médica única.

programme.desc: Returning to Venice, Louisiana for the first time in nearly a decade, Rush reconnects with longtime friends Eric and Monique Newman of Journey South Outfitters for an unforgettable inshore fishing adventure in the heart of the Mississippi River Delta. With reports of massive schools of redfish cruising the beaches, Monique (“Moe”) must decide whether to trust the intel and make a bold run down the coast—or rely on her own instincts built from years on the water. The mission is simple: put Rush on a true bull redfish and see if he has what it takes to earn a spot in her coveted “Over 40-Inch Club.” This trip highlights why Venice, Louisiana is considered one of the premier inshore fisheries in the country—and why having the right guide makes all the difference. Target Species: Bull Redfish. Location: Venice, Louisiana – Mississippi Delta. Outfitter: Journey South Outfitters.
